name: Crispy Chicken with Cauliflower Rice Pilaf and Fresh Greens

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a cast iron or oven-proof skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towel and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.7 kg chicken drumsticks
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until skin is golden and crispy, about 4 minutes; flip and repeat on the other side. Cook in batches is necessary.
Transfer chicken to a baking dish with a wire rack and place in the oven and continue cooking for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the leaves from the cauliflower. Using a food processor or box grater, grate to rice-like texture. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside.
Place a large pot over medium heat. Add butter, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, turmeric, cayenne pepper, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp turmeric
3 pinch cayenne pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter is fully melted, add the cauliflower and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add broth to the cauliflower and cook for another 5-7 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir into the cauliflower.
Cut lemons into wedges. Toss the mixed greens with oil and a squeeze of lemon.
To serve, arrange chicken, cauliflower-rice, and greens on plates. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired, enjoy!
